name: Story rail
summary: A row of story rings that scrolls sideways inside its box: your own add ring first, unseen stories in a colour ring, close friends in green, a live badge, and seen ones in grey.
use: at the top of a social or media feed, for the stories people have posted today
a11y: Each story is a button whose name says who posted it and whether it is new, live or seen; opening one marks it seen, and on wider screens two arrow buttons scroll the rail.
